todos.title: Create a Google Drive folder
todos.description: This would be shared with the SOC 2 auditors. Inside this main folder, later on, will be 58 folders (preferably name them 01 - 58) that will contain the evidence for each control.

todos.title: Provide screenshots of quarterly Board Meeting calendar invites + meeting minutes
todos.description: Quarterly board meetings are required for SOC 2 compliance. You need calendar invites and meeting minutes as evidence.

actions.label: Generate a quarterly Board Meeting invite

todos.title: Provide screenshots of quarterly Management Meeting calendar invites + meeting minutes
todos.description: Quarterly management meetings are required for SOC 2 compliance. You need calendar invites and meeting minutes as evidence.

actions.label: Generate a quarterly Management Meeting invite

todos.title: Provide Organizational Chart
todos.description: An organizational chart showing the company hierarchy and reporting structure is required for SOC 2 compliance.

todos.title: Provide screenshot/s of product description
todos.description: This can be the company public website, public docs or anything else public. Screenshots should show what your product does and its key features.

todos.title: Provide all company policies + Management calendar invite for review + screenshot that all company have access
todos.description: You can generate policies one by one under 'Actions/Generate Policies'. Make sure to also provide evidence of a management review meeting and that all employees have access to these policies.

todos.title: Provide a doc explaining where are you posting job descriptions + example of one job description
todos.description: Document where job postings are published (LinkedIn, company website, job boards, etc.) and include an example of a job description used for hiring.

todos.title: Provide Background Checks Process
todos.description: Document your background checks process for new hires. Different countries have different legal requirements.

todos.title: Provide Employee Onboarding process + screenshots of signatures
todos.description: Provide a doc that shows the process of how new employees get access to applications. The screenshots show that they actually completed the process.

actions.label: Generate 'Access to new apps process' doc

todos.title: Provide an NDA template
todos.description: Provide your company's Non-Disclosure Agreement template that is signed by employees and contractors.

todos.title: Provide Security Awareness Training materials + screenshots of signatures saying they read it
todos.description: Provide security awareness training materials and evidence that employees have completed the training.

todos.title: Provide Technical Training Resources + screenshots of signatures saying they read it
todos.description: These resources are for your employees. Provide technical training materials relevant to your stack and evidence of completion.

todos.title: Provide a screenshot of how you communicate new features to customers
todos.description: This can be your public docs, a Slack channel, email newsletter, changelog page, or anything else you use to communicate product updates to customers.

todos.title: Provide a screenshot of how you communicate new features to employees
todos.description: This can be your internal docs, a Slack channel, team meetings, or anything else you use to communicate product updates to employees.

todos.title: Provide an annual employee feedback template
todos.description: Provide an annual employee feedback template that is signed by employees and contractors.

todos.title: Provide a DRP and screenshots showing it in practice
todos.description: Provide a Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP) that shows the process of how you recover from a disaster. The screenshots show that you actually recovered from a disaster.

todos.title: Provide Risk Registry + screenshot of calendar invite + meeting minutes
todos.description: A risk registry documents identified risks, their likelihood, impact, and mitigation strategies. Include evidence of regular risk review meetings.

todos.title: Vendor Risk Assessment
todos.description: Provide a vendor risk assessment that shows the risk of each vendor. The assessment should include the vendor's name, product, type (usage), basis of processing, started using, stopped using, dedicated service account/email, confidentiality, integrity, stored sensitive data, availability, risk level, country, website, contact, GDPR/privacy statement, security statement, compliance, and SOC-2 report reviewed.

todos.title: Vendor Management Policy
todos.description: Provide a vendor management policy that shows the process of how you manage vendors. The policy should include the process of how you terminate vendors.

todos.title: Monitoring Tools & Alerts
todos.description: Provide screenshots of monitoring tools and alerts.

todos.title: Passwords Policy & MFA
todos.description: Provide screenshots of all MFA for production and deployment tools (GitHub, Cloudflare, AWS, etc.). Provide screenshots of the password policy of MDM, SSO, etc.

todos.title: Production MFA & Users
todos.description: Provide screenshots of all MFA for production tools (Cloudflare, AWS, etc.) and users.

todos.title: Deployment MFA & Users
todos.description: Provide screenshots of all MFA for deployment tools (GitHub, etc.) and users.

todos.title: Employee Offboarding Checklist
todos.description: Provide a screenshot/checklist of all the steps to offboard an employee. The checklist should include the steps to offboard an employee from all tools (GitHub, Cloudflare, AWS, etc.).

todos.title: Developer Production Access & Audit Logs
todos.description: Provide screenshots of all production access and audit logs. E.g. list of users in Cloudflare, AWS. etc. + audit logs.

todos.title: Architecture Design Document
todos.description: Provide a architecture design document.

todos.title: Source Control Access
todos.description: Provide a screenshot of users and MFA (as in #27)

todos.title: RBAC Document
todos.description: Provide a RBAC document.

todos.title: Employee Access Review
todos.description: Provide screenshots of the employee list for important systems (prod/deployemnt/Slack/Notion/etc.). Provide A table of all employees and their access to ALL systems.

todos.title: Physical Access Policy
todos.description: Provide the physical access policy.

todos.title: AWS SOC 2 Review
todos.description: Download the latest AWS SOC 2 review report. Go to 'Complementary User Entity Controls' and copy all the CC[X.Y] from the report into the action's prompt. If you're not using AWS just change the file name and some of the prompt.

actions.label: Generate AWS SOC 2 Review
actions.defaultPrompt:
From the provided list of SOC 2 report CC[x.y] - generate a table.
Columns: #, AWS CUEC Description, Process Description
# - the user entity control
AWS CUEC Description - the AWS description from the report
Process Description - the company process description

Complementary User Entity Controls:
{{Paste the list here}}

todos.title: Firewall Configuration
todos.description: Provide a screenshot of the firewall configuration. E.g. WAF or anything else.

todos.title: Vulnerability Scanning
todos.description: Provde screenshots of the vulnerability scanning results. Provide a ticket resolving a vulnerability.

todos.title: PenTest Report
todos.description: Provide the PenTest report.

todos.title: Antivirus Management
todos.description: Provide screenshots of the antivirus management policy (or MDM)

todos.title: Incident Response
todos.description:
- Provide a screenshot of an incident (ticket)
- Provide the Incident Management Policy
- Provide a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) - Date, Owner, Incident ticket number, Description, Root Cause, Fix Applied, Prevention (optional)

todos.title: Change Management
todos.description:
- Provide the Change Management Policy
- Provide the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

todos.title: Change Approval Process
todos.description:
- Provide branch protection rules for every production and deployment repo
- Provide screenshots of tickets and related merged PRs

todos.title: Deployment Authorization
todos.description: Provide screenshots of users of deployment tools (GitHub, etc.) - the same ones as in #27

todos.title: Test Status Requirements
todos.description: Provide screenshots of the test status requirements. E.g. github.com/{org}/{repo}/settings/rules/{ruleId}

todos.title: Password Encryption in DB
todos.description: Provide screenshot of the DB data that is encrypted.

todos.title: SSL Certificate
todos.description: Provide screenshot of the SSL certificate.

todos.title: Confidentiality Contracts
todos.description: Provide screenshots of some confidentiality contracts (just the beginning and the end of the contract).

todos.title: Data Disposal
todos.description:
- Provide screenshots of the full process of how a user deletes their data.
- Provide the Data Classification and Protection Policy.
- Provdide the Data Deletion Policy.

todos.title: Provide Section 3
todos.description: Section 3 contains detailed information about your company's control environment and security practices.
